same shaped recipe as minecraft:piston - three planks, an iron ingot, redstone and stone
crafting materials, for one piston. It exists as a fallback for Terralith's optional
recipe_changes overlay, which this pack does not enable, so all it does here is make JEI show
The condition below names a mod id that does not exist, so the recipe is never loaded at all
rather than loaded and hidden. The original body is kept verbatim underneath so a future
reader can see exactly what was removed without going into the Terralith jar.
